messages:
maria: Quick sync  proposing status page copy + timing for the eu-west degraded inference incident. Need sign-off for translations and inbound routing.
lauren: can you paste the proposed copy here so PMs and support can review?
aj: also need ETA for the fallback flip so ops and marketing align on the message.
maria: pasted below. Plan: 1) publish 'Investigating' now, 2) update to 'Mitigating' when fallback is live, 3) publish 'Resolved' with root cause and impact window.

maria: ```
Status: Investigating  Were observing elevated token latencies and partial failures for text-generation requests in hosted eu-west-1. Engineers are investigating and have enabled automated fallbacks for some requests. Well post an update within ~30 minutes or sooner if things change.
```
lauren: tone is good. Suggest adding customer-impact segmentation: "most users will see increased latency; a small subset may see request failures."
eli: +1. Also ask legal about saying "fallbacks enabled" if that implies tiered treatment.
maria: tweaked to: "most customers will see increased latency; a subset of high-concurrency requests may fail." avoids naming tiers.

sam: ops note  fallback to smaller model variant scheduled at T+20m after canary metrics. Publish 'Mitigating' then.
aj: Ill post here when the canary finishes. Also we should include a short ETA line on the status page.
maria: added: "Next update ~30 minutes; well post sooner if status changes."

maria: Draft schedule:
- Now: publish "Investigating" (maria)
- +20m: publish "Mitigating" when fallback confirmed (aj)
- +2h: if ongoing, publish expanded impact, workaround, and alert enterprise reps (maria/lauren)
- Resolution: publish RC, duration, and link to postmortem (maria)

eli: Routing: support should tag enterprise customers in Intercom and send a templated note. Marketing: can you prepare AE email + Slack snippet for rep handoff?
maria: yes. Preparing two variants: 1) short in-product status + link, 2) AE email with suggested subject lines and placeholders.

lauren: translations needed FR/DE/JP for status page + email templates. Marketing-ops: use vendor LangFlow, ETA 45m. If translations aren't ready by Mitigating stage, publish EN and append "translations pending".
maria: @ops-bot please open the translation request.
ops-bot: Translation ticket created: TICKET-4938. Vendor: LangFlow. ETA: 45 minutes.

eli: Marketing ruling  hold the benchmark post and webinar reminder until were fully clear. Recommend postponing external promos for 24 hours.
maria: pausing outbound promos and sending hold notice to comms.

aj: update: canary healthy, fallback live in canary, latency down ~38%. Posting 'Mitigating' now.
maria: published status: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1860018  copy updated with mitigation note and ETA. Pinging enterprise list.

aj: fallback fully healthy.
lauren: Marketing: please push AE email now and publish KB workaround: `set model_fallback=true` for SDK clients until full recovery.
maria: sent AE email and queued Intercom segment. Translations still pending (TICKET-4938).
sam: Ops will open a postmortem once resolved; draft expected in 24h. Add marketing to RC reviewers for the customer-facing postmortem summary.
maria: final tone note: be transparent, concise, avoid speculation. Include mitigation steps taken and clear next steps for customers. :thumbsup: :eyes:
